children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Read desired state, health, capacity, connection endpoint, and live game context before taking an action.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Treat state, conditions, events, and live game status as one story—not four independent indicators.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Confirm identity and current reconciliation state before opening an action or console.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Check server, cluster, namespace, template, version, loader, and uptime.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Distinguish Running, Starting, Suspended, Stopped, and Failed.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Check active players before Start, Stop, Restart, or console actions.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Use resource cards and the displayed endpoint to validate both workload health and the player network path.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Compare CPU, memory, and disk use with configured capacity.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Copy host and port together; verify service type and external routing.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Correlate metric changes with recent scheduling, image, probe, and agent events.

children.name: Section Title 3
children.text: Check game state and quick actions

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Save and communicate before changing world state, files, mods, versions, restores, or player-facing rules.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Identify → cluster, namespace, version, state, and uptime

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Validate → resources, endpoint, events, players, world state

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Save and broadcast → one action → confirm status and audit

children.name: Edit Page Body
children.text: Found a gap? Open a docs issue or suggest an edit on GitHub.
